parameters.content:
## Create property listing videos

### How it works
Take a pending listing from Google Sheets or Airtable and render a vertical photo tour with property facts and an agent contact card. Sheet mode stores the video URL; Airtable mode remembers processed records.

### Setup
1. Install **`@zvid/n8n-nodes-zvid`** from **Settings → Community nodes** before credentials. A workspace owner/admin may need to install it.
2. Create a **Zvid API** credential with [your API key](https://app.zvid.io/api-keys) and Base URL `https://api.zvid.io`. Select it on every Zvid node.
3. Connect both Google Sheets nodes to the same spreadsheet and tab. Set brandName, contactUrl and colors in Config.
4. For source=airtable, configure the base, table and optional view and attach a read-enabled Bearer Auth token. Use factual listing data and authorized photos.
5. **dryRun=false** renders and spends Zvid credits. Optional **dryRun=true** requires Zvid **Project → Create** support; published v0.1.8 does not expose it.
6. Test manually and review the output before activating automatic runs.

### Customization
Adjust branding, media and timing in the configuration node. [Detailed setup guide](https://github.com/Zvid-io/zvid-n8n/blob/master/workflows/real-estate-listing-video.md).

nodes.name: 1. Choose settings and an entry point

parameters.content:
## 1. Choose settings and an entry point

Complete the overview setup first. Use the manual trigger for a test, then check the trigger settings and workflow timezone before activation.

## 2. Read the listing source

Headers: Address, City, Price, Beds, Baths, Sqft, Photo1, Photo2, Photo3, Photo4, Photo5, AgentName, AgentPhone, AgentPhotoUrl, Status, VideoUrl. Require Address and two photos; leave Status empty.

## 3. Prepare the property facts

Use only the supplied photos and facts. Airtable mode does not write the video URL back; sheet mode does.

## 4. Check the background music

Check the configured track or stock candidates before use. Follow the guard’s result when music is unavailable.

## 5. Build and validate the design

Prepare the media and video design, then validate the payload and credit quote. Resolve validation errors before submitting a render.

## 6. Choose an optional editor preview

Default dryRun=false renders and spends credits. The optional editor draft branch needs Zvid Project → Create support, unavailable in published v0.1.8. Keep false with that version.

## 7. Render and wait for completion

Submit the render, then check its status until completion or timeout. Keep each result paired with its source item. Check Zvid before retrying a timed-out job.

## 8. Save the completed result

Write the completed URL back to its source row. Review the result before adding any further distribution steps.

## 9. Review the finished media

Open Watch video → Binary → data → View. Select each output item for batches; image outputs open as images. Empty links and preview results skip the download.
